about.title: About Nexo Mobility
about.subtitle: A boutique consultancy dedicated to accompanying Spanish companies as they expand into the United States.
about.story: Nexo Mobility was founded to reduce the uncertainty of international expansion. We serve as the single strategic partner that designs, coordinates, and accompanies each project — connecting Spanish leadership with trusted specialists in the United States.
about.mission: To reduce uncertainty during international expansion by providing Spanish companies with comprehensive strategic support and coordinated access to trusted specialists in the United States.
about.vision: To become the boutique consultancy of reference for Spanish companies seeking to establish themselves successfully in the U.S. market.

who.a: Spanish SMEs, family businesses, and industrial, technology, food, and services companies preparing to enter or grow in the United States.

diff.q: How do you differ from a traditional consultancy?
diff.a: We do not sell isolated services. We design and coordinate complete international projects through one trusted partner and a vetted ecosystem of specialists.

start.a: Most clients start with a Discovery Call, then Essential to validate the opportunity — or Professional when they are ready to implement.

locations.a: We operate between Miami and Barcelona, bridging Spanish companies and the U.S. market.
